name: Emily
source:
Emily is the first (and the last) doll Hanna created.
Unlike Will and the other dolls, Emily isn't an elemental one, so her life span is very little.

She is in love with Hanna and because of the extreme jealousy she feels for Will, she stops functioning. In order to fix her, Hanna must turn her into an elemental doll by collecting their keys.
